# TakeoutFix

> TakeoutFix is an independent project that helps people check Google Photos Takeout downloads and restore available dates or locations to supported media files. The browser restore tool processes selected media on the user's device. The site uses separate services for accounts, support, diagnostics, and advertising; see the Privacy Policy.

## What TakeoutFix does

Google Photos Takeout downloads may include extra `.json` files beside photos or videos. Depending on the item and the export, these files may contain details such as a date or location. Some photo apps do not use separate details files when importing media.

TakeoutFix can look for matching details files and add available information to supported media. Users should keep the original download, review unmatched files, and test a few restored copies in their destination photo app before processing a large library.

## Limits

- Not every media file has a matching details file, and a details file may not contain a usable date or location.
- Filename variations can make matching difficult. Review unmatched results rather than assuming every file was restored.
- Supported write behavior varies by media format. Consult the restore guide and verify sample output.
- TakeoutFix cannot recreate information that is missing from the photo and its export.
- Photo apps may display dates differently from file browsers, which can show when a file was copied or extracted.
- TakeoutFix is not affiliated with Google and cannot recover data from a Google Account.

## Privacy

The browser restore tool processes selected media on the user's device and does not upload those selected files to TakeoutFix. Other website features, including account sign-in, support, diagnostics, and advertising, may use network services. See the Privacy Policy for details.
